reason: I run 11-20 techs and maybe two locations on a POS that mostly works. Moving my tickets, clients, gift cards and payouts is a big risk for a new product, and $49 a month is not what I care about.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is, and 2.7% + 5 cents is Stripe's standard rate, so it is not obviously cheaper than what my processor gives me at my volume. A brand-new product with no track record is a risk when it is my whole checkout and my techs' pay. I also don't know if it handles two locations.
would_change_my_mind: A real card rate below what I pay now, shown against my own statement, plus another big salon my size that has run on it for six months and a way to run both locations.
